powershell: $d = Get-ChildItem $env:TEMP -Directory -Filter "pip-*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 3; foreach($x in $d){ "tmp=" + $x.Name + " mb=" + [math]::Round((Get-ChildItem $x.FullName -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum/1MB,1) + " age_s=" + [int]((Get-Date)-$x.LastWriteTime).TotalSeconds }; $c = Get-Counter "\Network Interface(*)\Bytes Received/sec" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty CounterSamples | Where-Object {$_.InstanceName -notlike "*loopback*"} | Measure-Object -Property CookedValue -Sum; "rx_kb_s=" + [int]($c.Sum/1KB)
